articles.title: Kraken parent Payward and its clients buy AAVE tokens in DeFi investment push
articles.snippet: The investment follows talks first reported by CoinDesk in June that included a proposed equity stake in Aave Group.

articles.title: Google could take stake in bitcoin miner TeraWulf’s $19 billion AI project if Anthropic defaults
articles.snippet: A $19 billion data-center agreement includes an unusual provision allowing Google to acquire part of the project if Anthropic fails to pay its rent.

articles.title: Ukraine’s central bank opposes crypto bill, citing monetary sovereignty concerns
articles.snippet: Ukraine’s central bank won’t back a crypto legalization bill in its current form and wants lawmakers to revise it before a final vote.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin drops more than 5% as stocks close out worst day since April 2025
articles.snippet: The continued blowup of the AI trade led markets lower, with Nvidia losing 9.3% and many other chip names down double-digit percentages.

articles.title: Bitcoin miner Riot could pay Anthropic 12% interest under $28 billion AI deal
articles.snippet: Riot has sold most of its bitcoin to fund its move into data centers. Its latest agreement gives Anthropic a way to finance part of the build and collect interest through rent deductions.
